name: Champagne
about: Genuinely cold winters, and grapes are picked earlier than other wine regions (late Aug–Sep) since sparkling wine wants less-ripe fruit.
overview: Reims and Épernay, home to the grand champagne houses and the underground chalk cellars (crayères) where much of the region's wine ages.
costOverview: Champagne runs expensive by rural French standards, though coffee and a bakery lunch stay normal — the tastings that define a visit range from modest to real luxury territory at the grand maisons.

specialSeasons.text: Harvest starts earlier here than most wine regions — grapes for sparkling wine are picked less ripe, so the vendange is usually done by late September.
